summary: Conduent Inc., through its wholly owned subsidiary Conduent Business Services, LLC, entered into an Equity Interest Purchase Agreement to sell all equity interests of Conduent Transport Solutions, Inc. and certain non-U.S. subsidiaries comprising its public transit and fare collection business (Transit Business) to Modaxo USA Holdings, Inc. and Modaxo France Holdings SAS. The purchase price is $164 million, subject to customary adjustments for cash, net tangible assets, indebtedness, and transaction expenses. Buyer will retain holdbacks totaling $10 million (NTA/indemnification) and $12 million (customer milestone), plus a holdback for representation and warranty breaches. Closing conditions include antitrust approvals, third-party consents, and absence of legal restraints. Watch for regulatory clearance and post-closing true-up mechanics.
